event_name: Document 36 Date 28 October 2018 Time 14:51 2018 MEXICAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Allegedly forcing car 10 off the track in turn 4.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence from several angles. Approaching Turn 4, Car 10 (Gasly) moved to the right to commence a pass on Car 31 (Ocon). Car 31 also moved to the right but left a full car's width to the edge of the track. Both cars appeared to brake late for the corner and the Stewards observed that Car 10 locked up his left front brake and understeered off the track.
rules_referenced: Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
team: Racing Point Force India F1 Team
title: Doc 36 2018 Mexican Grand Prix Decision Car 31 Turn 4 Incident With Car 10
